maria: Starting long-context validation for openlite-13b-int8 with the new pos-scaling patch. Reproducer below.

maria: ```
python infra/tests/longctx_runner.py \ 
  --model openlite-13b-int8 \ 
  --seq-len 32768 \ 
  --stitching on \n  --quant int8 \n  --prompt-file tests/fixtures/long_prompt.txt \n  --seed 42
```

jake: quick note — observed divergence when stitching across the shard boundary, around token ~18200. small log excerpt:

jake: ```
[2026-03-12 14:11:02] KV_SHARD 5 recv last_seq=18198 expected_seq=18199
[2026-03-12 14:11:02] model.out[18199] != ref.out[18199] (hash mismatch)
```

devon: can you paste the exact prompt used? also did you run the FP16 baseline?

maria: prompt is long prompt with repeated system preface + 4k-word doc (see tests/fixtures/long_prompt.txt). FP16 baseline (no quant) shows stable outputs up to full length, mismatch only in int8.

benchbot: bench summary (thread 1719200123): fp16 delta=0.00011, int8 delta=0.0467, top1 token mismatch=3.18% after 18k tokens. CPU: p3.8xlargish, runtime ~ 42m. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/longctx/1719200123/

ci-bot: Created issue <https://issues.redwood.ai/3421|#3421> "kv-cache interpolation drift across shard boundary" and assigned to @jake. Labels: bug, long-context, int8.

jake: hypothesis: our extrapolated-pos scaling path currently applies a linear alpha beyond model.max_pos which, combined with int8 kernel rounding, accumulates phase error. quantized rotary kernel likely loses the tiny sin/cos precision. trying a small patch: clamp alpha to 1.0 for pos > max_pos, rather than linear growth.

maria: I'll run the clamp experiment now. Setting env ROTARY_SCALE_MODE=clamp and re-running reproducer.

alex: also try lowering kv_shard.chunk_size to 512 for the run — that changes shard boundary alignment and may reduce stitch noise.

devon: if the reproducer is noisy, add a token-level KV checksum to pinpoint when KV keys diverge. I can add a --kv-checksum flag to the runner.

maria: added --kv-checksum, re-run started. benchbot will update when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

benchbot: benchbot: experiment complete. Results:
- int8 baseline: top1 mismatch 3.18% at token 18199
- int8 + ROTARY_SCALE_MODE=clamp: top1 mismatch 0.42% at token 24012
- int8 + clamp + chunk_size=512: top1 mismatch 0.31% at token 25260
Checksums show first KV key mismatch appears at layer 9, position 18197 for baseline, layer 12 pos 24010 for clamp. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/longctx/1719200123/exp-clamp/

jake: interesting — clamp pushes the drift later but doesn't eliminate it. suggests rounding noise still accumulates. next try: per-layer positional anneal (gradually taper scale from 0->1 across layers) to reduce sudden phase jumps at single layer.

maria: opening a short-lived feature branch with the anneal code and a tiny perf harness. Will push PR and link in issue.

ci-bot: CI: short tests passed. longctx_smoke failed (1/12) — failing test longctx_stitch_test.

devon: not blocking for the immediate fix, but let's queue an overnight eval run against the xlat-longctx set (800 samples) to capture quality regression curves. I'll add the job to the batch.

maria: thanks all. I've pinned the reproducer, kv-checksums, and bench artifacts in #3421. Leaving notes in the issue: steps to reproduce, env flags, and candidate mitigations (clamp, chunk_size, per-layer anneal). :thumbsup:

benchbot: artifacts + raw logs uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/longctx/1719200123/ (contains per-token checksums, per-layer kv-dumps, and diff plots).

maria: linking the artifact in the issue now.
